query: BEGIN READ ONLY; SET LOCAL statement_timeout='2000ms'; SELECT jsonb_build_object('function',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('definition_md5',md5(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)),'owner',pg_get_userbyid(proowner),'security_definer',prosecdef,'settings',proconfig,'acl',proacl::text,'anon_execute',has_function_privilege('anon',p.oid,'EXECUTE'),'authenticated_execute',has_function_privilege('authenticated',p.oid,'EXECUTE'),'service_execute',has_function_privilege('service_role',p.oid,'EXECUTE')) FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.oid='public.redispatch_stalled_searching_orders()'::regprocedure),'dispatch_work_exists',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.orders o WHERE o.order_status='searching' AND o.order_type NOT IN('intercity_ride','intercity_parcel') AND COALESCE(o.dispatch_worker_running,false)=false AND(o.dispatch_worker_started_at IS NULL OR o.dispatch_worker_started_at<now()-interval'20 seconds')),'terminal_cleanup_exists',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.orders o WHERE o.dispatch_worker_running=true AND o.order_status!='searching' AND o.dispatch_worker_started_at IS NOT NULL AND o.dispatch_worker_started_at<now()-interval'120 seconds'),'observed_at',clock_timestamp()) AS preflight; COMMIT;
